styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Christ the Redeemer, Santa Teresa and the old Centro.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Tijuca forest, Sugarloaf views and coastal walks.

stays.why: Classic beach base. Metro stations along the avenue, plenty of cheap eats and easy walks on the sand.
Nicer beach and better restaurants. Good for couples and first-time visitors who want to walk everywhere.
Central and well connected by metro. Close to Sugarloaf, Centro and nightlife in Lapa by taxi.
Cheapest and closest to museums and the ferry to Niterói. Quiet at night and weekends; check safety after dark.

food.tip: Try a feijoada lunch (black bean stew with pork) at a neighbourhood restaurant; portions are big, so share.
Eat at a kilo buffet (por quilo) for lunch: pay by weight and try many Brazilian dishes cheaply.
Grab a pão de queijo and a fresh juice from a corner padaria for breakfast.
Churrasco (grilled meat) rodízio restaurants are filling and popular; go hungry.
Beach vendors sell snacks and drinks. Carry small cash and keep your phone out of sight.

more_time.idea: Take the ferry (barca) from Praça XV to Niterói and see the Niemeyer museum and beaches.
more_time.detail: Cheap crossing, check times on the day.

more_time.idea: Spend a morning in Tijuca forest or a half-day hike to Pedra Bonita for views.
more_time.detail: Go early; weather can change fast.

more_time.idea: Do a day trip to Petrópolis or Búzios if you have a spare day.
more_time.detail: Bus or tour; long day, check schedules.

recommend.why: Three nights lets you do the big sights, a beach day and one night out without rushing.

month_notes: Jan: hot and wet. Highs 30°C, 15 rain days. Plan indoor or early outings.
Feb: same as Jan. Carnival time; book far ahead and expect crowds.
Mar: still hot and rainy, 14 rain days. Good for beaches between showers.
Apr: cooler and drier. Highs 27°C, 12 rain days. Comfortable for walking.
May: mild and drier. Highs 26°C, 10 rain days. Great all-round month.
Jun: coolest evenings, lows 19°C. Only 9 rain days. Bring a light layer.
Jul: driest month, 7 rain days. Cool nights around 18°C. Good for hikes.
Aug: dry and mild, 10 rain days. Pleasant days, cool evenings.
Sep: warming up, 9 rain days. Good balance of sun and comfort.
Oct: rain returns, 15 rain days. Short heavy showers are common.
Nov: wet, 16 rain days. Hot and humid; plan around afternoon rain.
Dec: hot and wet, 16 rain days. Festive season; book early.

climate_guide.summary: Tropical climate: hot most of the year, wetter in summer (Dec–Mar) and drier in winter (Jun–Aug).

items.title: Best months: May to September
items.text: Drier and milder, with highs 25–27°C and fewer rain days. Good for both beach and city walks.

items.title: Wet season: December to March
items.text: 15–16 rain days a month. Showers are often short and heavy; carry a small umbrella.

items.title: Hot summer
items.text: Highs around 29–30°C with warm nights near 24°C. Pace yourself and drink water.

items.title: Cool evenings in winter
items.text: June to August lows drop to 18–19°C. A light jacket helps at night and on the water.

items.title: Beach days
items.text: Beaches are busiest on hot weekends. Go early morning for space and softer sun.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light clothes, swimwear, sunscreen and a rain jacket. Add a light layer for winter evenings.

transit.best: Metro for the main areas; ride apps for nights and hillside spots.

modes.text: Lines 1 and 2 are fast and safe; fares around R$4.70.
Cheap (from R$4.70) but crowded; watch your belongings.
Taxis are metered; Uber and 99 work well.
Driving is confusing with poor signage; parking is hard. Skip it unless you leave the city.
Good in beach areas; bikes are popular along the coast.
Barcas link Centro's Praça XV to Niterói.
